children: Sandisk amended its loan agreement to provide for a revolving credit facility of $1.5 billion.
The new facility refinanced in full the revolving commitments outstanding under its existing loan agreement, according to a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The existing loan agreement from last year was with banks and other financial institutions, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent.
